SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.email, CASE u.role WHEN 1 THEN 'SALES' WHEN 2 THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as role, u.create_time, us.last_login_time, us.last_login_ip FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_user_status us ON u.id = us.user_id
AND u.role = #{role}
AND u.role IN (1, 2)
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
